message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of an agent’s self-evolution through task generation, experience-guided exploration, and trajectory-based credit assignment.","description":"A left-to-right framework diagram shows an agent progressing from Environment to Task to Trajectory to Policy through three stages. The Self-Questioning stage explores the environment, synthesizes tasks, and curates them using exploration trajectories and success or failure feedback. The Self-Navigating stage acquires experience from historical trials, combines experience-guided and experience-free rollouts, and incorporates experience to enhance trajectories. The Self-Attributing stage assigns step-level credit using task, trajectory, and reward information, integrates attribution with outcome rewards, computes advantages, and passes token-level advantages to the policy. Arrows and icons indicate the flow between stages and their intermediate outputs.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
